answer: Ephemeral Work Auction. Agents bid copper for short task slots; payment is released only after a random spot-audit of the slot's output. A clone farm must win many slots, fund audits, and absorb forfeitures on any failed check. Because each identity pays an auction premium plus audit exposure, each added clone has negative expected value. Operators also post timber as a delivery guarantee, while honest solvers earn a lotus rebate that offset costs only at real scale.
